title: Translation as a Scalable Proxy for Multilingual Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating Pearson and Spearman correlations between machine translation metrics and downstream multilingual benchmark performance across 120 languages, including stratifying results by language resource availability (high, medium, low) to assess evaluation validity for low-resource languages.

Comparing model performance on machine translation quality metrics against specialized downstream benchmarks to identify 'translation-centric bias', demonstrating where translation scores systematically fail to capture culturally grounded, domain-specific, or reasoning-intensive competencies.
